component.name: Quran Reader
component.summary: Read the Quran offline, without distraction

description.p: A Quran reader that keeps everything you need on your computer. The complete text and all 604 pages of the Madani Mushaf are built in, so it works from the first launch with no connection, no account and no tracking.

ul.li: Distraction-free reading: focus mode hides everything but the verses, and full screen is one key away
Auto-scroll at a pace you set, with a drag-to-adjust speed handle
Reading history: every Surah, Juz, Hizb and page remembers your place, and the Recent list keeps each sitting
Recitation from five reciters, all Ḥafṣ ʿan ʿĀṣim: hear one verse, repeat it to memorise, or listen to a whole Surah
Tafsīr Ibn Kathīr and Tafsīr al-Jalālayn, in Arabic and in English, beside the verse you are reading
Daily routines: read a set of Surahs such as Yā-Sīn, Al-Wāqiʿah and Al-Mulk as one, with today's progress
Mushaf page view with the printed line breaks, in the official KFGQPC fonts
Jump to any verse from the keyboard: 255, 2:255 or p255

description.p: Recitation and tafsir are downloaded the first time you ask for them and kept for offline use.

description.p: Whole Surahs stream in the listen panel, and on macOS the app gets native window controls, a menu bar and full screen.
Daily reading routines, and the Basmala now renders correctly on Windows.
